text_simplified: The Prophet ﷺ informed us of the immense reward for one who is patient and seeks Allah's reward when he said: "Allah the Exalted says: My believing servant has no reward with Me, when I take his beloved one from the people of the world and he patiently seeks reward, except Paradise" (Sahih al-Bukhari 6424). Shaykh Abd al-Aziz ibn Baz (may Allah have mercy on him) explained that kindness to daughters and children mentioned in the Prophetic hadiths is not limited to providing food, drink, and clothing, but encompasses raising them with an Islamic upbringing, teaching them the truth, and safeguarding their chastity and obedience to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.
